text.tspan: J1: 1/2 VIN 3/4/5 GND 6 CLR 7 LDAC 8 SYNC 9 SCLK 10 DIN
TPS7A4901: C14 provides NR / soft start
06A MCU SIGNAL GATING — local control and power are wired; only host/DAC interfaces use labels
06B SUPPLY WINDOW MONITORS — two divider chains and both fault outputs are explicitly connected
ENABLE inputs default LOW. Relay ON = PGOOD AND OUTPUT_ENABLE. Feedback stays BEFORE the output relay.
Startup: mute -> stable PGOOD -> SPI on -> DAC reset / midscale / reference / gain -> settle -> output enable.
Q3: 2N7002LT1G, +/-20V gate rating, supplier SOT-23 land pattern. Relay release is not instantaneous.
